name: @zhalker/gentle-shell-codegraph-subagents
description: Pi package that keeps CodeGraph reachable from gentle-shell subagents: normalizes agent tool lists and the codegraph MCP exposure on every session start, and pre-fetches CodeGraph for the explorer.
